ios.notes:
The 3D cover's sides now change with the Eclipse, and your friends see what you're playing without the delay.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.6

Fixed
- On the 3D cover, the sides now change when the Eclipse covers the front, instead of showing the next song's cover first.
- What you're playing reaches your friends right away again after a dropped connection. Before, it could stay on an old song for minutes.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.5...ios-v7.2.6

windows.notes:
Choose your own playlist cover, and see what your friends are playing without the delay.

Duotone for Windows 7.2.5

New
- Playlist covers: right-click one of your playlists and choose "Choose cover…" to use any picture. "Change cover…" and "Remove cover" are in the same menu. The cover shows everywhere, on your iPhone too.

Fixed
- What a friend is playing shows up right away again. After a dropped connection (the PC waking from sleep, a network blip), friends could stay on "Online" or an old song for minutes.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.1.0...win-v7.2.5

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
